chapters.headline: The Fed hikes into an oil shock

screen.headline: The Fed hikes into an oil shock
lines: The FOMC voted 12-0 on September 16 to raise the target range for the federal funds rate by a quarter point to 3.75%-4%, its first increase in more than three years, with updated projections pointing to the possibility of another hike this year.

chapters.headline: Crude gives the war premium back

screen.headline: Crude gives the war premium back
lines: WTI closed the week to September 15 up 13.6% at $107.02 a barrel, then fell to a $89.16 low on September 22 as reports circulated that Iran could reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days, recovering to $90.20 after Iranian sources denied it.

screen.headline: Cardboard's anniversary beats the Fed to the front page
lines: Pokémon TCG: 30th Celebration went on global sale on September 16, 2026 — the same afternoon as the rate decision — billed by TCGplayer as arguably the most hyped Pokémon set ever, with single boosters carrying a $16.95 market price before release and the headline products not due for another seven weeks.

screen.headline: The week in numbers
lines: Ten-year Treasury yield up 18 basis points on the week to 5.01%, its highest since 2007
Two-year up to 4.76% from 4.43%, leaving the two-to-ten spread at 25 basis points
WTI $107.02 on September 15, down near $89 by Tuesday
Nasdaq up 3.57% to 27,122 while the Dow slipped 0.71% to 52,049
Crypto Fear and Greed opened at 69, sagged to 50 midweek, closed at 78 — Extreme Greed
screen.note: Polymarket has Together at 19.5 cents to win 13% or more of the vote in the 2026 Knesset elections, on under a hundred dollars of volume — thin enough to treat as a curiosity, not a forecast.
